text:
adeel: compliance ping — tenant_c reported a few SSO sessions that ended up with 'superadmin' role after OIDC login. Not widespread but reproducible. Any recent claim transform changes?
hana: I merged a change to handle base64-encoded 'groups' in id_token last week (attempt to support a vendor). That was lib-claimify@2.0.0.
kevin: deploy-bot: deployed svc-auth@2025.04 at 1714999800 by kevin.
adeel: logs show the id_token groups arrived as a base64 string. Example (sanitized):
```
id_token.groups=\"W3sicm9sZSI6ICJ1c2VyIn0sIHsicm9sZSI6ICJzdXBlcmFkbWluIn1d\"
// base64 -> [{\"role\":\"user\"}, {\"role\":\"superadmin\"}]
```
adeel: our claimify.decode did a base64 decode and then the to_roles step flattened tokens by splitting on commas and stripping non-alphanum, which ended up picking up 'superadmin'.
hana: ugh. So two stages: base64 decode + naive tokenization. If the decoded payload is JSON array we should json.parse not tokenize.
kms-bot: kms: rewrap of alias kms/claims at 1714998000 by infra-ops-job-101.
adeel: correlation looks plausible — payloads were wrapped/encrypted for transport earlier. Rewrap could add quoting layers in some edge cases.
kevin: mitigation options: revert lib-claimify or toggle auto-base64-decode per-tenant config. Short-term prefer a config flag to disable auto-decode for tenant_c.
hana: I'll draft a PR to change to: if value matches /^\s*[\[{].*[\]}]\s*$/ then try JSON.parse first; else if looks base64 (^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$) then base64.decode -> then if result looks JSON parse it. Add unit tests with base64-wrapped JSON and double-quoted layers.
adeel: Also need to check SCIM provisioning side — our SCIM role mapping will create group membership when an incoming role contains 'admin'. We should audit SCIM pushes for tenant_c during window 1714990000-1715002000.
kevin: quick audit query: 
```
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN\" \"https://audit-api.internal/query?since=1714990000&until=1715002000&filter=source:scim&action:group.add\"
```
adeel: results: 4 group.add events for tenant_c, all for profile/read or group membership add, none destructive.
hana: OK low blast but still needs vuln-triage. I'll push config toggle to prod-safe-2 now.
deploy-bot: started canary: svc-auth config toggle -> prod-safe-2 at 1715002100.
kms-bot: alert-config-bot: created alert rbac_oidc_base64_parse -> severity: high -> notify: security-oncall at 1715002200.
adeel: rolling toggle applied. Monitoring 15m.
kevin: after you confirm no new admin maps, we can ship parser fix. Also schedule a KMS rewrap audit to ensure no further payload transformations.
adeel: 15m monitor complete — no new superadmin mappings. :thumbsup:
hana: follow-ups: PR #2746 to implement JSON-first parsing + UTs, add e2e with KMS-wrapped payload, update runbook for OIDC base64 edgecases, expand SCIM docs about vendor-encoded roles.
kevin: filing incident INC-4700 and assigning vuln-triage.
adeel: leaving thread open for postmortem notes and scan results.
